scope: CORE-MMU-FAULT-CUT: split MMU request capture from TLB/perm fault evaluation to break idex_d.inv_b -> mmu|fault_fsc_r combinational chain reported by T-20260902-028; preserve all exception/MMU semantics with fixed one-cycle MMU result delay.

implementation.summary: Added S_EVAL state after S_IDLE. S_IDLE only latches req_va/req_is_insn/req_is_write/access_el/pan into *_r registers and enters S_EVAL; S_EVAL uses the latched request to perform TLB hit permission, direct MMU-off passthrough, TxSZ/gap faults, or start page walk. tlb_hit and start_level_comb now use req_va_r instead of live req_va. Result registers (fault_fsc_r, fault_r, paddr_r, cacheable_r, par_attr_r, par_sh_r) are updated in S_EVAL, then S_IDLE with busy=1 produces done on the following cycle. All MMU translations gain exactly one result-cycle latency; core already freezes on data_trans_active/fetch_trans_busy and samples only at mmu_done.

semantics.esr_far_ifar_pc: unchanged values; only one-cycle later availability through existing done handshake
semantics.mmu_fault_type: unchanged FSC encodings and fault/PA attributes
